mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_suggestion (task_id, biz_type, biz_id, suggestion_type, content, accepted, accepted_by, accepted_at, status, create_time) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{suggestionType}, #{content}, #{accepted}, #{acceptedBy}, #{acceptedAt}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_suggestion WHERE biz_type = #{bizType} AND biz_id = #{bizId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
